error.title: Composition queued more than once
error.description:
## Composition queued more than once
Composition **{comp_name}** has **{count}** items in the Render Queue. Only one is allowed, because the render settings and output file name are taken from it.
This usually happens when the composition is queued again after a local render.
### How to repair?
- Click **Repair** to keep one item and remove the others, then **refresh** the publisher (circular arrow button). - It keeps the last item that hasn't been rendered yet, or the last one if all of them are done. - It also sets that item's output folder and file name, the same way AYON does when the instance is created. - Or remove the extra items yourself in *Window > Render Queue*, make sure the remaining one has *Output To* set, then refresh the publisher.
error.detail:
### __Detailed Info__ (optional)
Repair keeps the format and codec of the remaining item. Check its Output Module after the repair, in case the removed one had the settings you wanted.

error.title: Composition not in Render Queue
error.description:
## Composition not in Render Queue
Composition **{comp_name}** has no item in the Render Queue, so there is nothing to render or publish.
### How to repair?
- Click **Repair** to add it to the Render Queue, then **refresh** the publisher (circular arrow button). - Or add it yourself with *Composition > Add to Render Queue*, then refresh the publisher.
Check the Output Module of the new item, it uses your default settings.

error.title: Render Queue problem
error.description:
## Render Queue problem
The Render Queue item for composition **{comp_name}** couldn't be read:
{error}
### How to repair?
Open *Window > Render Queue*, check the item and its Output Module, then refresh the publisher.
